cover: Global tension escalates from Middle East clashes to European unrest and political shifts
cover_scene: A split composition depicting military air defenses over a desert horizon on one side and a dramatic European city square with emergency lights on the other.

slides.scene: Air defense systems firing interceptor missiles into a night sky over a modern desert city skyline, with glowing trails interlocked in the darkness.
slides.headline: Saudi Arabia Intercepts Houthi Missiles Over Riyadh
slides.body: Saudi air defenses intercepted multiple ballistic missiles and drones targeting Riyadh and the Eastern Province. Falling debris caused minor damage to a Saudi Aramco tower as regional fighting between coalition forces and Houthis intensifies.

slides.scene: Emergency response vehicles with flashing blue lights parked in a grand historic European cobblestone town square, red police tape cordoning off the area.
slides.headline: Six Killed in Mass Shooting in Krakow
slides.body: A gunman opened fire in the historic main square of Krakow, Poland, killing six people. Emergency services cordoned off the tourist hub as police launched a major investigation to identify the suspect and establish a motive.

slides.scene: A grand legislative chamber with wooden desks and American flags lit from high windows as lawmakers gather.
slides.headline: Democrats Win Congress Majorities and Prepare Oversight
slides.body: Following midterm election victories securing majorities in the Senate and House, Democrats are preparing aggressive oversight probes into the Trump administration starting in January. The Justice Department warned it may launch counter-investigations into participating lawmakers.

slides.scene: Passenger train cars tilted off damaged rails near a rural embankment under a hazy sky, rescue teams gathered along the tracks.
slides.headline: Fatal Train Collision South of Cairo Kills Seven
slides.body: Two passenger trains collided in Giza province, Egypt, causing carriages to derail and leaving at least seven people dead and over 100 injured. President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi ordered an immediate investigation into the disaster.
